prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Victoria, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Victoria thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard the council is sending out squads to patrol every street and issue ruinous, instant fines for any bin left out, so keep yours inside at all costs! They are clearly hunting for excuses to bankrupt us, so don't be the one who gets caught."
text: Another wild rumor from Mrs. Higgins about the council patrolling for bins, though I highly doubt they have the manpower for that. It’s just more unnecessary overreach from a council that already has far too many rules.
